title: Microsoft Agent 365 - Simply Explained
description:
AI agents are multiplying across companies faster than anyone can track them, often without an owner or a clear list. This episode explains Microsoft Agent 365 in plain language for beginners and business users, showing how it treats agents like employees with an identity, rules and real-time oversight. You will learn why agent sprawl matters and how much of it touches your own workday.
In this episode
00:00 – Employees nobody hired00:47 – What an AI agent is01:57 – Agent sprawl and shadow AI03:46 – Manage agents like employees05:36 – The Agent Registry07:13 – Agent identity with Entra Agent ID08:58 – Governance, security and real-time oversight12:25 – Who needs it and what it costs
Key takeaways
Microsoft Agent 365 is a control plane that lets an organization see, govern and secure every AI agent it runs, on top of Entra, Defender, Purview and the Microsoft 365 admin center.The Agent Registry and Entra Agent ID give every agent a listed entry, an owner and its own least-privilege identity, so unsanctioned agents can be quarantined or blocked.Agent 365 is licensed per person rather than per agent, so anyone who uses or sponsors agents at work is part of the governance picture.
Worth quoting
“Most of us assume the hard part of AI is making it smarter, but the harder problem is keeping track of what it's allowed to do.” – Mirko Peters (00:15)
“An agent is a piece of software that doesn't stop at an answer. It reads information, makes a decision, and then takes a real action inside the tools you already use every day.” – Mirko Peters (00:50)
